what: The hero starts empty, then at .5s the ink-black logo group floats up from 35px below over 1.8s, and at 2s the top one-line text opens from the left over 1.8s. At 4.5s the background photo fills the panel from bottom to top over 1.5s, and at 5s the logo and text colour change to the on-photo colour over 1.5s

options.scale: Multiplier applied to all durations and delays, default 1 — shrink for often-opened screens like .3, and 0 jumps straight to the end state
options.--fx-on-photo: Text color over the photo (via style), default --kf-contrast-ink

use:
Photo (slider)

One-line text

Logo (for SVG, fill: currentColor)
— mark sits layered over the photo
note: The original paints the logo as the background-color of a mask-image graphic. The part switches to color so it accepts both SVG and text — for a mask logo, use background-color: currentColor

from.where: index.html .tr-kv (key visual — logo .tr-kv__en · one line .tr-kv__jp · Splide photo .tr-kv__slider)
